content.text: The fix: added `overflow-hidden` to the flex-1 container at `chat.tsx:220`. Without it, the child div's `h-full overflow-y-auto` had no bounded height to scroll within — the parent would just grow instead. Now the parent constrains its height, and the raw messages div scrolls properly.
